### 1. Introduction
#### 1.1 Purpose
This document specifies the software requirements for **Student Micro-Lending & Instant Credit Platform (₹1,000 - ₹10,000)** operating in the financial domain. It serves as the single source of truth for software engineers, security architects, compliance officers, and executive stakeholders.

#### 1.2 Scope of Solution
The solution delivers high-assurance digital financial operations, incorporating automated risk scoring, multi-factor authentication checkpoints, and continuous regulatory adherence under central banking and data privacy standards.

### 2. Overall Description & SDLC Methodology
#### 2.1 Recommended SDLC Model: Agile-DevSecOps Hybrid (Fit Score: 82%)
**Engineering Justification:**  
The Agile–DevSecOps Hybrid model is selected because the financial project combines stringent security/compliance criticality (10/10) with the operational necessity for continuous delivery (8/10). By embedding automated SAST/DAST testing and compliance verification directly into iterative CI/CD pipelines, the engineering team ensures continuous audit readiness without sacrificing agile sprint velocity.

#### 2.2 Customized SDLC Workflow Phases
- **1. Sprint Planning & Threat Modeling**
- **2. Iterative Secure Coding & SAST/DAST Automated Scans**
- **3. CI/CD Automated Testing (Unit, Integration, Security)**
- **4. Regulatory Automated Compliance Checkpoints**
- **5. Production Canary Deployment & Zero-Downtime Monitoring**
- **6. Sprint Retrospective & Continuous Audit Feedback**

#### 2.3 Mandatory Quality & Security Approval Gates
- [ ] Automated Static Analysis (SAST) zero critical vulnerability gate
- [ ] Peer code review + Architecture approval
- [ ] Automated compliance test suite pass
- [ ] Infosec sign-off on pipeline secrets management

### 3. Specific System Requirements

| Req ID | Category | Requirement Statement | Priority | Applicable Regulation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `FR-WLT-001` | **Functional** | The system shall support a peer-to-peer mobile wallet allowing users to store up to $5,000, with a tiered KYC balance limit of $1,000 for Basic KYC and $5,000 for Full Video-KYC. | High | RBI PPI Master Directions |
| `SEC-MFA-002` | **Security** | The system shall mandate biometric fingerprint or MPIN authentication before executing any peer-to-peer wallet transfer exceeding $500. | Critical | PCI-REQ-8 / RBI PPI Directives |
| `INT-UPI-003` | **Integration** | The system shall integrate with NPCI / UPI BharatQR ecosystem for interoperable QR code payments and instant bank account withdrawals via IMPS/UPI. | Critical | NPCI Interoperability Directives |
| `AUD-LOG-004` | **Audit & Logging** | The system shall record immutable, cryptographic audit logs for all wallet top-ups, transfers, and Video-KYC records stored in domestic servers for at least 7 years. | High | RBI Data Localization / PMLA |
| `RES-SLA-005` | **Performance** | The wallet settlement engine shall support peak throughput of 1,000 transactions per second with 99.99% availability, RTO < 15 minutes, and RPO < 1 minute. | High | ISO 27001 High Availability |
| `COMP-TAT-006` | **Regulatory** | The system shall execute automated dispute reconciliation and T+1 auto-reversal with compensation for failed UPI transactions, supported by an in-app grievance portal. | Critical | RBI Harmonization of TAT |
